intro: Mozambique is a presidential republic ruled by FRELIMO since independence.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years; Daniel Chapo took office in 2025 after disputed elections. The Assembly of the Republic has 250 seats.

chapters.title: The north
